title: Very Tender Uruguayan Beef Stew
description: A hearty and romantic Uruguayan dish featuring tender beef and a blend of flavors, including mustard, slow cooked to perfection in a wok, inspired by Buddhist temple cuisine and nimono simmering techniques.
instructions: Combine beef pieces and brown mustard in a large bowl, mixing well to coat the beef evenly.
Heat olive oil in a large wok over medium heat, then add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the wok and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the coated beef to the wok, cooking until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the red wine to the wok, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom, then bring to a boil and cook until the liquid is reduced by half.
Add the beef broth, salt, and black pepper to the wok, stirring to combine, then bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is very tender.
Add the peeled and cubed potato and peeled and sliced carrot to the wok, continuing to simmer, covered, for an additional 30 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
